item.description:

**Synopsis:** After being rescued in New Orleans (The Parish), the Left 4 Dead 2 survivors are drafted and trained by the US Army as a special operations unit. Their new mission takes them to a hostile desert, where Russian military forces have weaponized the Green Flu virus. Inside a secret installation, the enemy has successfully engineered and contained a giant biological abomination. Backed by the US military, the survivors must infiltrate the desert base, fight through waves of Russian soldiers determined to stop them, and plant C4 charges to blow up the entire complex. **Campaign Structure (8 Chapters):** * **Chapters 1 to 7:** Tactical military combat. The main enemies are Russian soldiers; there are no infected present. * **Chapter 8 (Finale):** The infiltration peaks. As the explosives are set, the base collapses, unleashing the giant abomination and hordes of zombies for a chaotic final escape. ‎￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶ ￶￶ ￶

item.title: [ Mod ] Carryable Chainsaw
item.description:
View ArticleSteam Workshop
Media
Media gallery
1 / 2
This addon turns the chainsaw into a carryable weapon. That means you can use this weapon as long as you carry it without losing your current secondary weapon! Possible conflicts: Addons which modify the chainsaw script file "scripts/weapon_chainsaw.txt". For other incompatibilities see this [ link ].
